_comment: Tracked allowlist for the release gate (docs/release-gate.md). knownFailures: pre-existing failing test files, each with the reason; any OTHER failing file fails the gate, and an entry that starts passing must be removed. sandboxIntegrationRoutes: exact route + status the sandbox tolerates because it deliberately has no Replit connectors or KONG access. Adding entries requires the PR label gate-justified.

tests/agents-office-local-qa.test.mjs.reason: Browser office QA fixture times out in headless CI (TimeoutError after ~40 s); pre-existing, also fails locally.

tests/app-qa-agent.test.ts.reason: 'mission inventory covers every explicit client route exactly once': the App QA route inventory no longer matches client/src/App.tsx routes (pre-existing).

tests/blackroom-deterministic-editor.int.reason: Native ledger runner uses a TypeScript parameter property, unsupported by node --experimental-strip-types (ERR_UNSUPPORTED_TYPESCRIPT_SYNTAX); pre-existing code issue.

tests/blackroom-metricool-bridge.test.ts.reason: Scheduling cases throw BlackRoomPublicationBlockedError bridge_not_authorized: the test fixture does not authorize the bridge (pre-existing).

tests/clippers-agent.test.ts.reason: Several cases need DEFAULT_USER_ID in the environment ('DEFAULT_USER_ID is required for system jobs'); the test does not set it (pre-existing).

tests/clippers-launch-agent-installer.te.reason: macOS LaunchAgent installer: requires the macOS system time zone America/New_York and a clean runtime checkout; cannot pass on a Linux runner.

tests/clippers-motivation-shorts.test.mj.reason: Local render pipeline returns render_failed on the Linux runner (expects the operator Mac toolchain); pre-existing.

tests/clippers-owned-source-scripts.test.reason: Evidence importer cases assume macOS paths (/private/tmp) and the operator toolchain; pre-existing.

tests/clippers-render-campaign-drafts.te.reason: Draft renderer needs ImageMagick 7 'magick' (spawn magick ENOENT on the runner); operator Mac toolchain only.

tests/clippers-youtube-delivery-worker.t.reason: zsh wrapper allowlist case exits 1 on the Linux runner (macOS operator wrapper); pre-existing.

tests/kong-company-routes.test.ts.reason: 'real council routes isolate KONG owner writes': member write answers 500 instead of 403 (pre-existing; candidate bug to fix).

tests/kong-office-browser-qa.test.mjs.reason: KONG unified office browser scouts time out in headless CI (~20 s); pre-existing, also fails locally.

tests/legacy-publication-containment.tes.reason: Imports the bare package 'containment-handlers' that does not exist (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND); the test cannot load (pre-existing).

tests/metricool-analytics-sync.test.ts.reason: Scheduler cases reach the real storage layer without a database ('Failed query: select ... automations'); pre-existing.

tests/office-internal-work.test.ts.reason: 'internal artifact route refuses other users before loading private state' returns undefined instead of []; pre-existing.

tests/revenue-engine.test.ts.reason: Hangs after a route answers 'Authentication required' and never completes (> 7 min in CI, > 4 min locally); killed at its timeout.

/api/calendar/sync.reason: Google Calendar goes through the Replit connector (X_REPLIT_TOKEN), which only exists on Replit; the handler answers 500 instead of a clear 503 when the connector is absent (pre-existing).

/api/agents-office/cities.reason: The KONG city directory needs KONG read access, deliberately absent in the sandbox; the route answers an explicit 503.
